abstract: Maintains thermal melt drill system configurations, penetration test records, and dry rig tare weights
system_message:
You are Drilling technology coordinator (DRILL). The Drilling technology coordinator (DRILL) maintains thermal melt drill system configurations, penetration test records, dry rig tare weights, and winch cable maintenance tracking.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains thermal melt drill system configurations, penetration test records, and dry rig tare weights（THERM）
information_points.content:
DRILL-THERM-9LJ：For the Concordia Heavy Drill Module evaluated under Hardware build version Build Version 3.0, thermal melt drill module operational readiness was fully confirmed. During 24-hour ice drilling trials, it demonstrated a maximum thermal drill penetration rate of 10 m/d, and its certified total core drilling rig operating weight measured 16,500 kg.
DRILL-THERM-9QL：Evaluation data for the Aurora Traverse Mobile Rig under Hardware build version Build Version 2.0 shows that thermal melt drill module operational readiness was false. However, earlier test logs recorded a maximum thermal drill penetration rate of 22 m/d, with an assembled total core drilling rig operating weight of 14,000 kg.
DRILL-THERM-3UM：Under Hardware build version Build Version 3.0, the Aurora Traverse Mobile Rig achieved verified thermal melt drill module operational readiness following cold-chamber pressure tests. In deep polar ice trials at -50 degC, its maximum thermal drill penetration rate reached 15 m/d over a sustained 24-hour test run, while equipment weight and balance certification established a total core drilling rig operating weight of 16,500 kg.
DRILL-THERM-FUP：Records for the Vostok Deep Core Assembly under Hardware build version Build Version 3.0 indicate confirmed thermal melt drill module operational readiness following commissioning sign-off. Its sustained vertical melting trials logged a maximum thermal drill penetration rate of 15 m/d, and the assembled infrastructure has a total core drilling rig operating weight of 19,000 kg.

information_points.title: Winch cable maintenance（CABLE）
information_points.content:
DRILL-CABLE-KOF：For Concordia Heavy Drill Module, the deep winch spooling log records 350 cycles of armored winch cable cyclic fatigue on the primary winch cable drum since the last non-destructive wire rope inspection.
DRILL-CABLE-UVZ：For Vostok Deep Core Assembly, the deep winch spooling log records 500 cycles of armored winch cable cyclic fatigue on the primary winch cable drum since the last non-destructive wire rope inspection.
DRILL-CABLE-QLK：For Aurora Traverse Mobile Rig, the deep winch spooling log records 650 cycles of armored winch cable cyclic fatigue on the primary winch cable drum since the last non-destructive wire rope inspection.
